text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the first day of summer camp.<n>Having
recognized Shinko Windy's<n>achievements, the
other Umamusume<n>are making a fuss over her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is overjoyed by the<n>attention. In the
hopes that one day<n>the whole world will praise her
in the<n>same manner, she resolves to use<n>her time at
camp to train for a spot at<n>the top.
